items.name: Synthetic.Modules.AutoTagger.Commands.CmdBatchTag
items.tooltip: Automatically tag all valid elements in the active view (or current selection) using your saved Universal Auto-Tagger templates.

sub_items.name: Synthetic.Modules.AutoTagger.Commands.CmdManageTemplates
sub_items.tooltip: Open the Universal Auto-Tagger control panel to view, delete, import, or export tag templates.

items.name: Synthetic.Modules.DetailItemFactory.Commands.CmdDetailItemFactory
items.tooltip: Batch process selected elements into 2D Detail Item families via DWG tracing.

items.name: Synthetic.Modules.MergeDuplicates.Commands.CmdMergeDuplicates

items.name: Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.Commands.CmdProjectStandards
items.tooltip: Launch the Project Standards Workspace to load, stage, batch edit, and enforce standard configurations.

sub_items.name: Synthetic.Modules.MaterialManagement.Commands.MaterialsRepathAll
sub_items.tooltip: Command will replace the file paths for the selected materials based on a series of selected file paths to search.  The first instance of the file will be chosen based on the order of the paths.

sub_items.name: Synthetic.Modules.MaterialManagement.Commands.MaterialImagesPackage
sub_items.tooltip: Copy all material bitmap images to a new folder location.

sub_items.name: Synthetic.Modules.MaterialManagement.Commands.PaintElements
sub_items.tooltip: Paints all faces of the selected elements with the chosen material.

slideout_items.name: Synthetic.Modules.FamilyManagement.Commands.AuditPurgeAllFamilies
slideout_items.tooltip: Command open each family in the project, checking it for warnings and errors as well as purging it and deleting all schema in memory.

slideout_items.name: Synthetic.Modules.FamilyManagement.Commands.FamiliesForceReinsert
slideout_items.tooltip: Forces a reinsert and overwrite of all families.  This can fix some post upgrade issues such as when text in families revert back to default font style.

items.name: Synthetic.Modules.Worksets.Commands.WorksetsImport

items.name: Synthetic.Modules.Worksets.Commands.ScopeBoxesMoveToWorkset
items.tooltip: Moves all scope boxes in the project to a selected workset.

sub_items.name: Synthetic.Modules.Worksets.Commands.WorksetSetFile

sub_items.tooltip: Sets the project information (like start view) from the Excel file

slideout_items.name: Synthetic.Modules.Worksets.Commands.ElementsOnWorksetRecord
slideout_items.tooltip: Records the elements on a workset in a text file to be recalled later.

slideout_items.tooltip: Reloads a list of elements from a file and moves them to the workset listed.  Command will create the workset if it doesn't already exist.
